in_universe.label: 1993 (time travel to 1603)
in_universe.note: The plot revolves around a mystical scepter which transports the Turtles and April back in time to feudal Japan … In 1603 feudal Japan, samurai capture Prince Kenshin after chasing him into the woods … Category:Films set in 1993

release.note: Wikipedia: The film was released theatrically in the United States on March 19, 1993, by New Line Cinema.

in_universe.label: After the 1990–93 films (disputed)
in_universe.note: TMNT co-creator Peter Laird stated it takes place in its own universe separate from the previous films, but director Munroe says the film exists in the same continuity as the other films, which was supported by the memento wall at the end of the film.

release.note: Wikipedia: TMNT premiered at the Grauman's Chinese Theatre in Los Angeles on March 17, 2007, and was released theatrically in the United States on March 23, by Warner Bros.

links.note: disputed: the director says it shares continuity with the 1990–93 films; Laird says it does not
